comments.body: Does anyone use these and if so do you use regular enough?

comments.author: Juicebox
comments.body:
This item puts you and the party in berserk status. Your attack doubles and piercing rises basically all your regular attacks do as much as a critical and your criticals do a whopping 4x the normal damage just one problem it cuts your defense in half and you cant use techs or items until it wears off. Its VERY risky and will probably have your entire team cursing you out for using it. This is an experts item and will either lay waste to the enemy instantly or get your team wiped out.

I use it to speed kill when the enemy cant attack (blind, paralyzed), or if an enemy can be one shotted or if the enemy is attacking someone else or if im kiting with a gun or bow behind an obstacle basically when I know I can't/wont be hit. I prefer you use tonic or celtic war paint as it doesn't affect the entire party so you or others can use wings or heal.

Its a rarely used item due to its risk but high reward it has it uses so you better damn well know what you're doing before using it. You have been warned…
